notes.title: Your Steam Creatures Now Deal Bonus Damage! - Phase 1
notes.content:
Hey Guys

This is actually a really cool update and i wanted to say thank you first of all to my friend SLMEPHI for spending hours with me to get this working and having the patience of an absolute saint

Your steam creatures now deal bonus damage ingame giving them an actual purpose rather than just being a collectable

These are the rates:

Common Creatures:
0.5% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

Uncommon Creatures:
1.5% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

Rare Creatures:
3% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

Relic Creatures:
5% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

If you go to the profile page you will see a new button that says "Steam Collectables" and this will show the common creatures that you have collected in your steam inventory along with the possible bonus damage and dumber of creatures collectable

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/a9afcc9a271effbae8d4f9bfc317ce3280cdee15.png[/img]

Each time you obtain a new creature it will show up in the collectable room

At this time only the commons room is visible but the uncommon, rare and relic room are coming this week but their damages are already active, here's where you can see your total bonus damage:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/30c630815037ce8ade7ce492f6ef202236e72ddd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/15d85cc0e17a1b1904b8548fd56110d93e8e4021.png[/img]

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Mini Update: 23/06/2024
notes.content:
Added a possible fix for save data losses during BSOD or power outages but it's untested so i will need feedback

Every 10 minutes the game will make a backup save using the engines inbuilt save feature, if your computer ever suffers a BSOD or your game is suddenly ended during a power cut etc, head on over to the profile page and then you will see a little button in the bottom right hand corner, click this button and then click the alarm button to "recover" your save data, do this first as you will have 10 minutes until a new backup is made and will overwrite the old data

As i say, this is untested so if you lose your save data and attempt recovery using this method, please let me know the outcome

PS: this is a new addition and will not recover save files that have previously been lost, it makes a new save every 10 minutes so will only recover when this backup is made 

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Creature Clicker - The Conversion Update

I was going to hold off on this update for a few weeks but it has an important change that will help a lot of players with a back log of Ascension Shards

New Feature:
Conversion

You can now access the conversion manager via the profile page and this will allow you to exchange your unused Power Shards & Cards for Boss Souls, this is a feature that was requested by several players so i hope you guys find it useful

notes.title: Creature Clicker - The Big Ascension Update
notes.content:
Hey guys

I hope you're well

So today is the launch of the Big Ascension Update which brings a lot of changes to Creature Clicker to hopefully make it a much more enjoyable and engaging experience and lay a solid foundation for future updates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/675543e2da2c4c3da40d71752603dff010f7f975.png[/img]

Before i start i just wanted to say thanks a lot to everyone who has supported me over the years

Also you can grab Creature Clicker for a massive discount this week:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/529240/Creature_Clicker__Capture_Train_Ascend/

I'm going to go over the features and changes of this update:

Unfortunately i couldn't get cloud saves working although i tried, i'm going to have to look further into this for the next update

Update 1:
Creature Clicker now has over 50 creatures inclusive of ascended forms and variations and every creature has been renamed to fit with their ascended forms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/f30a1bc060592c67b1b0e2bcf011cf106be95013.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/f2154ceceaac4c74d3c835074a9f8a6721620120.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/4267b83ff6e3beb2e36653772084508234e5bec9.png[/img]

Creatures now have 3 phases of ascension that changes their form, however there are currently 3 creatures in the game that have ascension variation forms which can be unlocked by completing their relevant challenges, you can switch between these variations once you've unlocked them

There's also over 100 new achievements in this update for you achievement hunters, i hope you enjoy them!

Update 2:
The entire game has had a graphical overhaul, all of the zones have backgrounds that match the area and a lot of the other rooms in the game have had a similar graphical overhaul, unfortunately due to time constraints i couldn't get round to doing all of the rooms but rest assured they will be patched in the next update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/4473970fb8449a357413084a22d8cb38922b1b4d.png[/img]

Update 3:
Creature skills are now much more powerful but no longer can they be purchased using gold, I would really recommend starting a new game so that you get the benefits of these new skill sets. Also there's a new currency being introduced in The Big Ascension update called Ascension Shards and these can be obtained by defeating creatures, unascended creatures have less chance to drop shards than Ascended creatures. You will now find that 1st Ascension creatures will spawn and are tougher than unascended creatures but they give much higher chance of ascension shards and also higher xp rewards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/d6d9d0ebbf936f91d20a72d55b236ea0fad91316.png[/img]

Mini bosses that spawn every 12 levels are now Final Ascension creatures and they drop much more Ascension Shards 

Update 4:
Raid Bosses have had a lick of paint to make them fit more with the game's aesthetics and they also talk to you as you battle them, however i couldn't finish them all in time for this update so i've released the ones that i have finished and the other ones will be released in the next update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/be83b348abbf17bc2906943240414adb5a5d4007.png[/img]

Update 5: 
Creature Clicker now has it's own OST, it replaces the generic Life of Riley loop 

I hope you enjoy this update and i'm sure there are bugs, i've changed so much code in the game and i've tried to test everything but i'm only 1 man so if you find a bug please report it and i will patch it

Again, thanks a lot for the support, i really appreciate it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/475a46b6f8d2b1ab8de139488da77544845f8fc7.png[/img]

PS: let me know which creature is your favourite, personally i think Tyranrai is the coolest but i'm looking forward to hearing your opinions, suggestions and feedback!

~Lee

notes.title: Creature Clicker - The Revamp Update!
notes.content:
Hey Guys

It's been a while! i have a big update for you all today

I've totally revamped the UI making it much more accessible and less complicated so that everyone can get started with Creature Clicker

There's quite a lot of changes so i'll go through the list

1: Controller Support

You can now play the entire game with a controller, simply press "start or select" when you're ingame and it will spawn a controller icon that you can play the entire game using, so this means you can play Creature Clicker on your TV if you want and this brings me on to the next feature

2: CO-OP support

With the integration of controller support, you can have 4 controllers connected at once so you can have multiple friends for double, triple or four times the damage!

I would assume this will work with Remote Play Together but i've not had a chance to test that feature yet so any feedback would be much appreciated

3: Creature Menu Revamp

I've totally revamped the UI for the creature menu and now everything is on one page and you can easily click between creatures and see what their individual stats are without having to come in and out of confusing menus

4: Loot Menu Revamp

Using the same concept as the creature menu revamp i have updated the equipment menu, you can click through and see exactly what equipment each creature has, what level it is and what the bonus DPS from the equipment is

5: Equipment Revamp

Equipment from chests has been updated so that it's more fairer to achieve a fully equipped creature. now when you find equipment in a chest, it will level up the piece that you've found to the next stage and also the chance of finding equipment in chests is much, much higher

Also every creature now has equipment so happy hunting!

6: Cookery Update

The construction menu has been changed to enable it to be more useful, now when you purchase upgrades for your farm it will also generate ingredients such as cheese, eggs and fish to craft into meals for your creatures that give temporary bonuses

7: Quality of life improvements

The entire game has had a sound pass and UI revamp to make the experience cleaner and feel more responsive to your inputs

I hope you enjoy this update and as always please let me know if there's any bugs or glitches you come across so i can assess and fix them asap

Thanks for your support

~Lee

notes.title: Creature Clicker - Wasp Nest & Forest Cards Update
notes.content:
Hi Guys

A new update is now live for Creature Clicker, now if you have a Farm unlocked you will start to attract Wasps to your farm

The default attraction rate is 10% and this can be increased to 40% via wasp sugars which give +10% attraction rate per sugar, wasps are farmed automatically when you are on the main screen and this is how the Nest works

When you are on the main screen of Creature Clicker, you will be automatically attracting Worker Wasps

Every 10 Worker Wasps will merge into one of 4 different hybrid wasps

Fire Wasps = +100 DPS
Ice Wasps = +10 Click Strength
Hex Wasps = +1% Crit Chance (Has a limit)
Toxic Wasps = +50 Crit Damage


There is also the new collectable cards which give you +5 click strength per level

There's 8 cards to collect and each card can be leveled from Bronze, Silver, Platinum so you can have +15 Click Strength per card to a maximum of +120 Click Strength

The cards are farmed in the same way wasps are, by chance drops at random intervals


Other Updates:

Another small addition is the cursors which are available on the profile page, these are currently only accessible through DLC purchases

Thanks for the support guys

I really appreciate it

~Lee

notes.title: Update #9 - Snake & Scorpion Loot, Cheevo Optimizations
notes.content:
Hey Guys

Hope you've all had a great week so far

Sorry i haven't been able to update this week as much as i normally do but i've been working extra hours in work and it's really cut into my game development time, hopefully get a lot more content released for you guys next week

I had a bit of extra time tonight to do some updates for Creature Clicker, so now you can obtain the loot for the Snake & The Scorpion, i have also optimized the way the game checks for achievements, instead of it running all achievement scripts, it does it incrementally so that it's not having to read around 5000 lines of code in one go every 30 seconds, now it will read 1000 lines, and then another 1000 lines every 30 seconds and this will loop through all the achievement checks

I'm hoping this will fix the crashing that some players have been experiencing

notes.title: Update #6 - The Quests / Jobs Update
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

Hope your having a great day / evening

I have a new feature in todays update, this is the new jobs update (quests) and this is the first iteration of this feature, there are currently 2 quests in the game but this is just to beta test this weekend and ensure it works fine without any crashes / bugs

If all goes well then i will add a lot more quests on Monday, oh and whilst were on the subject, i will be away again this weekend until Monday so the updates will continue then :)

So here's a little rundown on the update, every 5 - 15 levels (random) you will get offered a job which will appear on your screen like a little scroll to inform you that you have a job waiting, if you click this scroll (or click the exclamation icon on the trainer profile) it will take you to the job

[img]http://www.phatphrogstudios.com/Job1.png[/img]

You can either accept or decline the terms of the Job and then either way it will go onto a timer of 5 - 15 levels again before you are offered a new job,

If you don't decline or accept then the job will remain there, you can do this if you want to keep a job and save up for the terms of it

I will see you guys on Monday!

Have a great weekend

~Lee

notes.title: Update #5 - Introducing the Raptor, Rock Golem & Ankylo
notes.content:
Hey Guys

Hope you all had a great day

Quite a big update for you guys, i have added 3 new creatures, these creatures can be tamed at level 96+ at the Sarak Desert

They give a base DPS of 20 and they are harder to level than the Phoenix but provide a much higher DPS per level

Also i have added the Rat Loot which brings me on to a massive change to how the loot system works, loot is now creature specific and it will only drop when you have an eligible creature equipped, if you open a chest and you do not have a creature than can currently obtain loot then you will not get loot, however if you have a creature selected that can, then the loot will always be relevant to that creature selected. this will make it easier to farm loot for a specific creature

On that note, you can also get loot from silver chests now but it's at a much rarer chance. three times rarer to be specific

Fixes & Touches:

Gold now shows on the trainer skill page (thanks Kaela!)
Optimizations

Thanks for your continued support, please report your bugs on the forums!

Thanks

~Lee

Get the game here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/529240/Creature_Clicker__Capture_Train_Ascend/

notes.title: Update #3 - Treasures & Loot
notes.content:
Hey Guys

Hope you are all good today

Todays update addressed a few bugs from yesterdays update, it has put the framework in place for tomorrows update and also introduced some extra features to bring even further interactivity to the game, you can now find treasure chests that drop from random creatures

These treasure chests come in 2 varieties, silver and gold. The silver chests drop a small amount of gold and the gold chests drop a lot more

These chests will appear on the side of your screen, if you have more than one then you can click through them one after the other

Thanks guys

Please report your bugs on the forums

~Lee ːsquirtyayː

notes.title: Update #2 - An Enchanting Update
notes.content:
Hey Guys

How you all doing?

Well it's been a crazy weekend, thank you guys again for your support and suggestions. I am here to bring you update #2 which brings enchanting onto the table in Creature Clicker. Enchanting? i hear you say.. well enchanting is a feature that gives the game more interactivity which is what a lot of reviewers were saying that the game lacked and to be fair, they had a point so i have expanded on this.

Enchanting:

Enchanting is a feature that lets you spend some gold on increasing the DPS of a creature, all the way up to a maximum of 250 enchants. You can enchant a stage 1 creature to 100 and then a stage 2 creature to 200 and then finally a fancy stage 3 creature can be enchanted to 250.

This also gives the creature ascension system more reason to be used

How do i enchant?

You will find the enchant button just below the Ascend button on the creature overlay screen, you will also notice that the Ascension button has changed, i switched the sprite for ascension with the enchanting button just because they make more sense that way

[img]http://www.phatphrogstudios.com/cc.png[/img]

I will have more for you in the next few days

Thank you again

PS: if you get a chance, please follow my new company facebook page to keep up to date and get notifications of promos and updates

http://www.facebook.com/phatphrogstudios

~Lee

notes.title: Update #1 - Profiles!
notes.content:
Hey Guys

I've just got back from my vacation and i'm working my way through the errors that have been reported over the weekend. i have decided to quote the report and then do a follow-up so that you guys know i'm reading your comments and listening to your feedback so here we go!

Error #1:

[quote=jeppe.rafn]Lets start a thread with all error code we get in the game so its easier for the dev to get an overview :)

Great game so far on it's first day, looking forward to getting more creatures :)


___________________________________________
############################################################################################
ERROR in
action number 1
of Mouse Event for Left Pressed
for object obj_selectscorpionbutton:

Trying to read from undefined INI file
at gml_Object_obj_selectscorpionbutton_Mouse_4
############################################################################################ [/quote]

This has been fixed and is included in the latest hotfix! thank you for the report Jeppe!


Error #2:

[quote=Aura Of The Dawn]'crafting' (upgrades for starter pet, flame dragon in this case) say 'not available until level 15'. Enabled for me at level 11, despite being 'baby char' instead of juvenile.

Both the first sword and first armor were something I was allowed to create [/quote]

[quote=rileypatton69]you can open the crafting menu before level 15 and also craft things [/quote]


Thank you for the report guys, this has been addressed and is now fixed in the latest hotfix!


Error #3:

[quote=derdibbuk;1318836262662681805]I craft the second armor, but the picture is still gray and it shows me how much Resources i need. And always when i click some were in the crafting menu the levelup line from my dragon pops up. [/quote]

[quote=255ThePhiphi;1318836262666265480]I had enough bronze and 5 silvers, so I tried to craft the Silver Caparace, but it didn't work (and some lines from my dragon appeared too). But then I tried crafting the Weapon of Resolve and it worked... even though it needs 6 silvers. I could have found one when I was in the crafting menu, but maybe something's broken here ;) [/quote]

Thanks guys, they have both been fixed and put in the latest hotfix 


[b]New Features based on player suggestions:[/b]

Thanks for all the error reporting, now to the juicy stuff, the updates!

[b]Feature #1 - Level Ascension![/b]

[quote=rileypatton69]i went back stages and i not sure, but is there a way to go back up? (i had the smart idea to go all the way back to 3 from 37) [/quote]

This has been added, thank you for the suggestion, after level 5 you can now ascend back up to the highest level you have already reached by right clicking the new ascend button on the top right near the descend button


[b]Feature #2 - Profiles![/b]

You guys have been shouting out for this feature, so here it is. You can now choose between 6 different profiles that you can switch to on the fly. Each profile will have its own stats so if you have any friends or you want a different dragon breed then you can switch between them
